initial_test_hypothesis.label: Narrow B2B or merchant-workflow pilot
initial_test_hypothesis.suggested_test: Interview a small set of identifiable organizational or merchant buyers before committing broad distribution; validate contract value, payment integration and support needs.

priority_research_gaps: Sector-specific licences and ownership exceptions
Product-market size and customer budgets
Foreign-worker rules and current merchant-onboarding conditions

initial_test_hypothesis.label: Merchant operations or export-linked B2B validation
initial_test_hypothesis.suggested_test: Test collections/reconciliation or an export-chain workflow with one partner; separately model energy and transport exposure rather than assuming consumer demand is strong.

priority_research_gaps: Current comprehensive personal-data requirements and sector interpretations
Foreign land/ownership rules for the actual entry mode
Current product-level competitor prices and consumer affordability

initial_test_hypothesis.label: One-city, one-segment launch test
initial_test_hypothesis.suggested_test: Start with a named city, customer segment and channel; compare local workflow integration, acquisition costs and delivery/settlement economics before geographic expansion.

priority_research_gaps: Original BKPM capital rules, investment thresholds and KBLI exceptions
Personal-data law, tax and product approvals for the proposed activity
City/island-specific logistics and channel economics

initial_test_hypothesis.label: Partner-led affordability and payment pilot
initial_test_hypothesis.suggested_test: Verify local settlement and actual payer budgets with a local partner; test usage, collection success and foreign-currency cost exposure.

priority_research_gaps: Original investment-law commencement and implementing rules
Current data, foreign-ownership, currency and remittance requirements
Provincial coverage, purchasing power and current competitor pricing

initial_test_hypothesis.label: Vertical SME productivity pilot
initial_test_hypothesis.suggested_test: Choose one operational bottleneck and customer vertical; test onboarding time, willingness to pay and measured labor/error savings against existing tools.

priority_research_gaps: Activity-specific licences and service-sector equity conditions
Current tax, e-invoicing applicability and sector approvals
Segment-specific willingness to pay, acquisition cost and partner quotes

initial_test_hypothesis.label: Enhanced review before commercial commitment
initial_test_hypothesis.suggested_test: Do not commit capital or counterparties on this pack alone; first resolve legal/sanctions nexus, ownership, payment route and local operating conditions.

priority_research_gaps: Live sanctions lists, beneficial ownership and applicable jurisdictions
Current digital/cybersecurity, banking and foreign-exchange rules
Local security, power, connectivity, delivery and customer payment reliability

initial_test_hypothesis.label: Automation or merchant-workflow pilot
initial_test_hypothesis.suggested_test: Test a specific services/merchant workflow with observable buyer ROI; separate digitally active customers from those with budget and buying authority.

priority_research_gaps: Exact activity under the 13th negative list and capital exceptions
Sector approvals, tax and employer requirements
Buyer budgets and current local competitor pricing

initial_test_hypothesis.label: Narrow specialist B2B use-case validation
initial_test_hypothesis.suggested_test: A focused accounting integration or sector-specific workflow is a hypothesis, not a demand finding; require buyer interviews and evidence of payment before recommending scale.

priority_research_gaps: Activity-specific financial, health, education or import permissions
Tax, employment, transfer safeguards and procurement conditions
Customer acquisition costs, sales-cycle length and segment-specific demand

initial_test_hypothesis.label: Industrial or sector-specific partner pilot
initial_test_hypothesis.suggested_test: Select an identifiable factory, food or tourism buyer and validate a productivity problem; investigate the exact foreign-business and platform conditions early.

priority_research_gaps: Exact Foreign Business Act exemption and business activity
Current privacy and platform-notification applicability
Local distribution, language support needs and competitor commercial terms

initial_test_hypothesis.label: Small, partner-led market validation
initial_test_hypothesis.suggested_test: Validate a small cohort of real buyers, payment acceptance and connectivity; do not size the market from ASEAN accession or development needs alone.

priority_research_gaps: Sector-specific rules, customs and effective trade-agreement schedules
Current privacy, payments, immigration and tax requirements
City-level buyer counts, connectivity and verified commercial-channel terms

initial_test_hypothesis.label: Localized B2B workflow or supply-chain pilot
initial_test_hypothesis.suggested_test: Test an export/manufacturing or business-workflow niche with local-language implementation and integration checks before proposing a broad software replacement.

priority_research_gaps: Current investment implementing instruments and restricted activities
Current tax, e-commerce, cybersecurity and sector-specific approvals
Buyer segment, local-language workflow and competitor commercial terms
